title: Brock Purdy: We have what it takes to win Super Bowl, but know nothing is guaranteed

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brock Purdy: We have what it takes to win Super Bowl, but know nothing is guaranteed
sources.description: The 49ers have spent plenty of time in the playoffs during Kyle Shanahan's time as their head coach, but four trips to the NFC title game and two trips to the Super Bowl have not ended with anyone in their uniform hoisting a Lombardi Trophy.
